description: Get the FULL TEXT of a section of the Ohio Revised Code — Ohio state statutes — by citation. "ORC 2903.02" is section 2903.02 (murder). Returns the statutory text (the section body only, with no surrounding page text) and its effective date as a separate field; `text_scope` says what a given answer contains. Keyless. Use for "what does Ohio Revised Code 2903.02 say", "text of ORC 4511.19", or to check an Ohio statute a case relies on.

section.description: Section as cited, e.g. "2903.02" or "4511.19". Title and chapter are encoded in the number.

name: oh_revised_code
title: Oh Revised Code
